tasks.brief:
Implementation constraints: Edit src/static/style.css. Replace the bodies of exactly two existing CSS rule groups. No other edits to this file. No JavaScript, no async, no external libraries. The selectors must remain exactly as they are; only their declarations change.

Behavioral specification: Replace the declarations of the two search-hit rules as follows:

1. mark.search-hit: background var(--toggle-on-bg), color inherit, border-radius 3px, padding 0 2px.
2. mark.search-hit.current: background var(--accent), color var(--accent-contrast), border-radius 3px, padding 0 2px, outline 2px solid var(--accent-hover).

Acceptance condition: src/static/style.css contains the two rules with the exact selectors and declarations specified above.
